acceptanceCriteria: A benchmark at 100k records with long claims shows index derivation allocation reduced materially (target under 1 GiB) with identical index output.
body: Observed by the V1-1995 lane (PR #1264) while scaling query-index bounds: deriving the query index allocates per-claim EvidenceTerms slices totalling about 5.4 GiB at 100k records with long claims. Measured in the lane's capacity test, not on a live corpus.
title: Per-claim EvidenceTerms allocation reaches 5.4 GiB at 100k records with long claims
